notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
This update changed the following
- DLSS updated to version 2.2
- Volumetric clouds with shadows 
- Optimized foliage
- New textures on some structures
- Player HUD improvements
- Better help text

notes.title: Crash fixes
notes.content: Fixed crashes at the starting areas.

notes.title: Update 2 - More Music
notes.content:
Landscape optimized with new grass.
Music will now play all the time.
Volume of some sounds has been adjusted.
Force feedback on supported controllers - this is not the same as haptic support.

notes.title: Update notes for initial patch
notes.content:
-Increased the size of your hands grab radius to allow for easier grabbing of objects.
-Changed the look of your weapons and grapple to have skins that are more professional.
-Change the placement and size of some information signs to not cut off some of the text.
